title: 3D-printable medal design reference dictionary
purpose: A non-asset design dictionary for editor development, visual QA, and printability test fixtures. Observations describe reusable layout patterns only; no third-party geometry, logos, illustrations, or product photographs are bundled.

fieldSemantics.observedPatterns: Visual or manufacturing patterns worth testing in the editor, not artwork to copy.
fieldSemantics.frontBack: Whether the published reference visibly treats one or both medal faces.
fieldSemantics.licenseRisk: Editorial implementation risk based on source type and visible intellectual property; this is not legal advice.
fieldSemantics.reusePolicy: The maximum safe reuse intended by this project. Source-specific licenses must still be checked at use time.

references.title: Custom 3D-Printed Medals – Personalized for Any Event
observedPatterns: Round body with a clearly separated border
Large event-first typography
Theme icon plus personalized date or distance
Ribbon width collected as an order parameter
references.colorStrategy: Two to four high-contrast PLA colors with metallic variants
references.frontBack: Front personalization; listing offers optional back personalization
references.reusePolicy: Pattern study only; do not copy seller artwork, photography, wording, or exact composition

references.title: Beer Olympics Medal
observedPatterns: Simple circular blank supports quick customization
Large central symbol remains legible at coarse nozzles
Short top loop keeps the medal compact
references.colorStrategy: Single body plus one contrasting face color
references.reusePolicy: Use generic layout lessons only until the current source license is verified

references.title: Podium / Winners Medals
observedPatterns: A consistent family for first, second, and third place

references.reusePolicy: Recreate only the generic podium-system idea with original geometry and typography

references.title: FormFutura Podium Medals

references.title: 2024 Olympic-Inspired Medal

references.title: Helldiver-Themed Medal

safeExampleTargets.title: Night City 10K
safeExampleTargets.originality: Original project-owned composition; generic night-running theme only
acceptanceCriteria: Reads as a night race at 20% thumbnail scale
Runner has recognisable head, torso, bent arms, and two separated legs
No decorative stroke is below the selected nozzle minimum
All text remains editable
Three or four color slots can be reassigned independently
Front and back export as valid separate 3MF material regions

safeExampleTargets.title: Summit Trail 21K
safeExampleTargets.originality: Original project-owned mountain and trail composition
acceptanceCriteria: Mountain, trail, and distance are distinguishable without reading small text
At least three editable relief heights are visible in isometric view
Laurel rim prints without detached islands
Back graphics remain flush to the back face
Uses no protected race logo or copied map

safeExampleTargets.title: Podium Classic
acceptanceCriteria: One parameter changes rank and associated metallic color
All three ranks share identical outer dimensions
Largest numeral remains printable with 0.8 mm nozzle
Personalized back text is flush rather than unsupported relief
Batch quote can price all three variants

safeExampleTargets.title: Honey Run
safeExampleTargets.originality: Original bee-and-honeycomb race theme; no copied commercial bee artwork
safeExampleTargets.attachmentStyle: single slot integrated into top cell
acceptanceCriteria: Bee is made from clean closed vectors and remains recognisable at 45 mm diameter
Honeycomb cells never create walls thinner than nozzle rules
Black/yellow/cream palette has accessible contrast
Every cell and bee region is independently recolorable
No source portfolio geometry is reproduced

safeExampleTargets.title: Junior Champion
acceptanceCriteria: A novice can finish personalization by changing only name, sport, and colors
Name auto-fits without stretching glyphs
Star points and rosette necks pass the selected nozzle rule
No detached islands exist
Works as a single-color print and as a four-color print

safeExampleTargets.title: Geometric Aquathlon
safeExampleTargets.originality: Original swim-run composition with generic human motion symbols
acceptanceCriteria: Swim and run disciplines read as two distinct editable objects
Wave bands use no more than three relief heights
Cut slit preserves the configured bridge thickness
Mirrored back view displays text correctly from the outside
Two-color fallback remains understandable

safeExampleTargets.title: Forest Orienteering
safeExampleTargets.originality: Original topographic and compass composition generated from primitives
acceptanceCriteria: Contour lines are smooth at 200% view and printable at the selected nozzle
No map or course data from a real event is bundled
Offset attachment keeps the hanging orientation within five degrees of upright
Objects remain selectable independently
Back checkpoint code is flush and color-separated

safeExampleTargets.title: Community Relay
acceptanceCriteria: Four figures remain visually distinct without relying only on color
Wing segments are connected to the body and meet minimum feature width
Team name can be changed by direct text editing
The design supports up to six colors but has a tested three-color reduction
PDF export shows front, back, side, weight, price tiers, and material assignment
